dsr.sharpe_dispersion_source: every development backtest in the full grid (not survivors)
unresolved: Effective-trial count is estimated from the eigen-spectrum of the full-grid development return correlation matrix; the estimate is bounded by the number of days (rank) and the choice of estimator (Li-Ji vs participation ratio) moves DSR materially.
The earlier ICT Silver Bullet search has no recorded trial count, so it is not included in any trial total.
Threshold changes across funnel_v1..v3 are additional researcher degrees of freedom not captured by a config count.
Trial-Sharpe dispersion includes configs with very few trades, whose noisy Sharpe inflates the variance (and so the benchmark).

survivor_table.note: not run in `develop`; run the `validate` command on the frozen manifest
